title: Almanac dossiers
hook: **Almanac** files what you meet — dossiers from **your** playthrough, not a wiki somebody else wrote.

blindSpots.meaning: The reference layer (`A`) for creature types, elements, statuses, recipes, and effect families as they become visible.
A filed record of something you discovered — portrait, pedia text, costs, type info.
An empty slot means you have not met it yet — not a broken link.
Raw export pages are not the almanac. If it looks like a dump, it is not for players.

alsoTrue: Some dossiers are still thin; presentation polish continues.
Chronicle (`H`) is the history / XP ledger sibling — not the same layer.

sections.title: What it is
paras: See something in the game and the RPG files it.
You end up with a browsable set of dossiers and fusion recipes you uncovered — a record of your run through the war.

sections.title: How it works
sections.intro: Reference material, open over any stage:

groups.title: Almanac layer (`A`)
groups.intro: Open over Sanctum or any stage when the rail allows.
steps: Meet something in play (lawn, expedition, map — wherever discovery fires).
Browse dossiers and recipes; empty slots are unmet, not errors.
groups.note: Older “types / recipes / runs” routes redirect here as the Sanctum model finishes replacing old audit screens.

doSteps: Play until you have met at least one new type or recipe.
Open Almanac (`A`) and find that dossier.
Leave one empty slot alone — that is discovery state working.
doNote: Stop when almanac ≠ wiki download. Sibling ledger: [chronicle](chronicle).

mixUps.a: You have not discovered them yet. Empty means unmet.
No. Chronicle is history and XP ledgers (`H`).
Design allows completion milestones without every exclusive lawn capture.

mixUps.q: Is a raw data dump the almanac?
mixUps.a: No. Developer dumps are not for players.
